XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for the CodeAtelier question type

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key references question.id.

FIELD.NAME: language
FIELD.COMMENT: Code language. Practice: python, sql or javascript. Judge: c, cpp, java, python or javascript.

FIELD.NAME: tier
FIELD.COMMENT: Execution tier: practice (in-browser, formative) or judge (server sandbox, authoritative grading).

FIELD.NAME: scenario
FIELD.COMMENT: Question scenario: stdinstdout, function or sql. Selects the run harness and comparison.

FIELD.NAME: entrypoint
FIELD.COMMENT: Function name to call for the function scenario.

FIELD.NAME: startercode
FIELD.COMMENT: Starter code shown in the student editor.

FIELD.NAME: schemasql
FIELD.COMMENT: SQL scenario: schema + seed (DDL and INSERTs) loaded before the student query.

FIELD.NAME: cputimelimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Judge tier: per-question CPU-time limit in seconds. Null uses the site default.

FIELD.NAME: memorylimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Judge tier: per-question memory limit in kilobytes. Null uses the site default.

FIELD.NAME: languages
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated set of languages the student may choose from. Empty means single-language (the language field).

FIELD.NAME: starters
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON map of language to starter code, for per-language starters when several languages are allowed.

FIELD.NAME: referencesolution
FIELD.COMMENT: A reference solution (in the primary language) used for validate-on-save and run-to-capture.

FIELD.NAME: allornothing
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 grades all-or-nothing (full marks only if every test passes); 0 allows weighted partial credit.

FIELD.NAME: functionsignature
FIELD.COMMENT: Typed function signature for static-language judge grading, e.g. 'int,int->int'. Empty for dynamic languages.

FIELD.NAME: projectfiles
FIELD.COMMENT: Project scenario: JSON array of starter files [{name, content}, ...] for a multi-file question.

FIELD.NAME: entryfile
FIELD.COMMENT: Project scenario: the entry/main file name Judge0 compiles and runs.

FIELD.NAME: checkerlang
FIELD.COMMENT: Custom checker: the judge language the checker program is written in. Empty means no custom checker (use the declarative matching rule).

FIELD.NAME: checkersource
FIELD.COMMENT: Custom checker: a teacher-supplied program that decides AC/WA per test, reading (input, expected, output) as three files and printing an AC or WA token. Judge stdin/stdout scenario only.

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key references question.id.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display/run order of the test case.

FIELD.NAME: input
FIELD.COMMENT: Input fed to the student code (stdin, SQL setup, or function args).

FIELD.NAME: expected
FIELD.COMMENT: Expected output or result set.

FIELD.NAME: matchmode
FIELD.COMMENT: Declarative matching rule: exact, trimmed, regex, float, structured, resultset or resultset_ordered.

FIELD.NAME: tolerance
FIELD.COMMENT: Absolute tolerance, used only when matchmode is float.

FIELD.NAME: weight
FIELD.COMMENT: Relative weight of this test case for partial credit.

FIELD.NAME: visibility
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 shown to students, 0 hidden (polite-hidden in the practice tier).

FIELD.NAME: checkerquery
FIELD.COMMENT: SQL scenario: query run after the student's statements to verify a mutation; empty means compare the student query's own result set.

FIELD.NAME: feedback
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional teacher feedback shown for this test case (visible tests only).

FIELD.NAME: selector
FIELD.COMMENT: Web scenario: the CSS selector this DOM assertion targets.

FIELD.NAME: assertproperty
FIELD.COMMENT: Web scenario: the property checked - text, exists, count, attr:NAME or style:PROP.

FIELD.NAME: assertmatcher
FIELD.COMMENT: Web scenario: how expected is compared - equals, contains or regex.

FIELD.NAME: actions
FIELD.COMMENT: Web scenario: optional interaction steps run before the assertion (click/type), one per line.

FIELD.NAME: subtask
FIELD.COMMENT: Subtask group id (IOI-style). 0 is ungrouped (per-test weighting); a positive id groups tests for all-or-nothing credit within the group.

TABLE.NAME: qtype_codeatelier_judgecache
TABLE.COMMENT: Memoised judge-tier grading results, keyed by a hash of language+code+tests+limits. Deterministic sandbox runs, so review and regrade read this instead of re-running Judge0.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 of the canonical (language, code, test set, limits) signature.

FIELD.NAME: fraction
FIELD.COMMENT: The graded fraction in [0, 1].

FIELD.NAME: verdict
FIELD.COMMENT: The judge verdict: AC, WA, TLE, RE or CE.

FIELD.NAME: resultblob
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of the full grading result (per-test outcomes, compile output).

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When this result was first computed.

TABLE.NAME: qtype_codeatelier_proctorlog
TABLE.COMMENT: Server-side, append-only record of soft anti-cheat events on judge-tier attempts (focus-away, outside-paste). Written by an authenticated AJAX call during the attempt and stamped with the server's time and the authenticated user, so it cannot be forged or altered through the page like the former hidden field could.

FIELD.NAME: questionattemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: The question_attempts.id the event belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The authenticated user who generated the event (server-set, not client-supplied).

FIELD.NAME: eventtype
FIELD.COMMENT: The event kind: focusaway, extpaste, extdrop.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Server time the event was recorded.
